sources.summary: Spanish studio Typsa Arquitectura has completed a library in Luanda, Angola, with a curving concrete roof punctured by openings that encircle existing trees on the site. Located at the centre of Luanda's technology park, the 1,915-square-metre library was designed around the site's existing mature trees, which determined its footprint, spatial organisation and roof design.
